name: Miki Saburou
source:
A member of the Shinsengumi who was invited in by [url=/c1477]Heisuke[/url]. [url=/c47226]Kashitarou's[/url] younger brother.
He tries to act cheerful, but he's always worrying about things.
He's usually a reserved person, but when he drinks he becomes an unthinkably daring man.
He wishes to live in peace, but his life in the Shinsengumi that reeks of blood makes causes him much pain.
